aliases: What a workplace emergency plan should include

one_line_answer.text: A workplace emergency procedure includes an emergency plan and emergency equipment.

cites.quote: The procedure
will include an emergency plan and emergency equipment.
A workplace emergency plan should include:

bangla_explanation: Emergency হলে কী করতে হবে তা আগে plan করা থাকলে মানুষ নিরাপদে বের হতে পারে।
Plan-এ আটটি বিষয়: reporting procedure, alarm, duties, escape routes, communication, key people, drills, building map।
Drills নিয়মিত করতে হয় আর তার record রাখতে হয়।
Emergency Response Plan workplace-এ সবার চোখে পড়ে এমন জায়গায় টাঙিয়ে রাখতে হয়।

example.en: A technical training centre puts a building map near each door. It shows escape routes and the safe meeting area.

short.prompt: What should a workplace emergency plan include?
short.modelAnswer:
A workplace emergency plan should include:
1. Reporting Procedure
2. Description of alarm system
3. Duties and responsibilities
4. Escape routes and safe meeting area
5. Communication method
6. Names and numbers of key people
7. Regular drills
8. Map of the building

keyPoints.text: Employees and visitors must know the emergency arrangements, usually at induction.

cites.quote: Employees and visitors to site must be aware of the emergency arrangements for the
this is usually part of the induction

keyPoints.text: Anybody with an emergency response role must get the necessary training.

cites.quote: Anybody who has an emergency response role must be aware of their responsibility
provided with the necessary training

keyPoints.text: A reporting procedure says what to do when an emergency happens.

cites.quote: Reporting procedure is the process to what to do when the
emergency situation happened
